210:     return sklearn_silhouette(X=sklearn_X,
211:                               labels=labels,
212:                               metric=sklearn_metric,
213:                               sample_size=sample_size,
214:                               random_state=random_state,
215:                               **kwds)
216: 
217: 
218: def _check_initial_guess(init, n_clusters):
219:     if hasattr(init, '__array__'):
220:         assert init.shape[0] == n_clusters, \
221:             "Initial guess index array must contain {} samples," \
222:             " {} given".format(n_clusters, init.shape[0])
223: 
224: 
225: class TimeSeriesCentroidBasedClusteringMixin(TimeSeriesMixin):
226:     """Mixin class for centroid-based clustering of time series."""
227:     def _post_fit(self, X_fitted, centroids, inertia):
228:         if numpy.isfinite(inertia) and (centroids is not None):
229:             self.cluster_centers_ = centroids
230:             self._assign(X_fitted)
231:             self._X_fit = X_fitted
232:             self.inertia_ = inertia
233:         else:
234:             self._X_fit = None
235:         self.n_features_in_ = X_fitted.shape[-1]
